title: The Janus-facedness of the aryl hydrocarbon receptor pathway Report of the 6th International AHR Meeting: Research, Prevention, Therapy.
authors: Haarmann-Stemmann, Thomas; Reichert, Doreen; Coumoul, Xavier; Lawrence, B Paige; Perdew, Gary H; Sherr, David H; Weighardt, Heike; Rolfes, Katharina M; Esser, Charlotte
one_liner_zh: 该文是AHR转录因子通路国际会议报告，概述AHR配体感知与疾病关联，仅提及AI用于配体设计，未聚焦TF-DNA结合互作建模，与本课题关系边缘。
abstract: The ability to sense and process environmental cues is a fundamental aspect of an organism's biology. The evolutionary ancient transcription factor AHR (aryl hydrocarbon receptor) has evolved in animals to sense low molecular weight compounds derived from environmental exposure, dietary plants, the gut/skin microbiome, or generated endogenously from tryptophan upon ultraviolet light (UV) exposure or enzymatic catabolism. The binding of such molecules results in a cascade of events leading to the transcription of target genes. The AHR gene locus was first identified in mice in 1982. Since then, the beneficial and detrimental effects of AHR agonist-driven activation or lack thereof have been studied, particularly in relation to environmental chemical toxicity, carcinogenicity, or tissue homeostasis, e.g. barrier tissues. AHR ligands are also being considered as a potential new therapeutic class of molecules for the treatment of cancer, debilitating and chronic inflammatory diseases or metabolic disorders. A series of international meetings initiated twenty years ago have provided a comprehensive overview of AHR research. At the meeting in Dusseldorf in 2024, the identification of tailor-made ligands using modern, artificial intelligence (AI)-based approaches was a key topic of discussion, as were current attempts to resolve the dual nature of AHR activation - beneficial and harmful. While our understanding is still in its infancy, research was also presented that highlights previously unrecognized roles of the AHR in many diseases.
abstract_zh: 感知和处理环境线索的能力是生物体生物学的一个基本方面。进化上古老的转录因子AHR（芳香烃受体）在动物中进化，以感知来自环境暴露、饮食植物、肠道/皮肤微生物组，或由色氨酸在紫外线（UV）暴露或酶促分解下内源性生成的低分子量化合物。这类分子的结合引发一系列事件，导致靶基因的转录。AHR基因位点于1982年首次在小鼠中被识别。自那时起，AHR激动剂驱动的激活或其缺失的有益和有害效应已被研究，特别是在环境化学毒性、致癌性或组织稳态（如屏障组织）方面。AHR配体也被视为治疗癌症、衰弱性慢性炎症疾病或代谢紊乱的潜在新型治疗分子类别。二十年前启动的一系列国际会议提供了AHR研究的全面概述。在2024年于杜塞尔多夫举行的会议上，使用现代基于人工智能（AI）方法识别定制配体是讨论的关键主题，当前解决AHR激活双重性质（有益与有害）的尝试也是如此。尽管我们的理解仍处于初级阶段，研究也展示了AHR在许多疾病中先前未被认识的作用。
